seeding.note: Particles were seeded across the reported slick extent (16.35 km major axis, 0.60 km minor axis) by the frozen Baseline V1 reconstruction, not at the centroid alone. The extent comes from the alert record, not from observed geometry.

interpolation: SciPy RegularGridInterpolator, linear in time and bilinear in space
warnings: No weathering, diffusion, Stokes drift, beaching or oil-volume physics.
Sensitivity scenarios are not calibrated probabilities.
Particles encountering missing ocean forcing are marked inactive.
